notes.title: Fighting for food, Approx 1 month until release.
notes.notes:
Hi guys, just thought I would keep you up to date with the latest news.

With about 1 month to go before  final release, Fighting For Food  seems to all going well, with the animations, functionality and gameplay all coming together nicely.

At this point it seems that the game release date appears  to be on track . 

Happy Gaming!

SevenSeas Software
